svg.aria-label: Confidential values are replaced by placeholders before reaching the model, then restored for the user and for tool calls

g.text: You are a support assistant. A value that looks like personal
data is already a placeholder: never guess the real one…
What's the first letter of my first name?
I can't tell, that name never reaches me.
Can you email me the summary?
Nothing it doesn't need to know.
